name: Meta-Stamp Pockets
description: Meta-Stamp Pockets: licensing and receipts for AI agent access to creator content. Every visit goes on the record: a licensed pull returns the content with a receipt, a refused one returns a receipt that says no, and the owner's ledger gets the same entry. The owner sets the price, per asset.

auth.description: API key required. Get one at https://app.meta-stamp.com/customer-signup

tools.name: pull_content
tools.description: Pull licensed content from a Pocket. Returns the content with its license and a receipt. The owner sets the price, per asset.

tools.name: search_pockets
tools.description: Search for available Pockets by keyword. Returns matching Pockets with their metadata.

tools.name: list_pockets
tools.description: List available Pockets, optionally filtered by creator. Returns Pocket metadata without content.
